newsitem.title: UK: CE challenges Northern on tax change.
newsitem.headline: CE challenges Northern on tax change.

text.p: CalEnergy Co Inc of the U.S., making a hostile bid for Northern Electric Plc through UK takeover vehicle CE Electric, on Wednesday used a tax change introduced in Tuesday's budget to challenge its bid target.

In a statement, CE said that new depreciation rules "could have the effect of increasing the amount of tax Northern Electric pays. This may have a significant negative impact on the value of Northern Electric shares."
"We would expect Northern Electric to comment on the impact of the tax rule changes in connection with the release of their interim results this week," CE said.
Northern, which is expected to report its interim results this week along with what it calls "important financial information", has rejected a bid from CE at 630p per share.
While CE has bought nearly 30 percent of the company's stock in the market, it has received acceptances for just 3.4 percent at the bid level.

In its statement CE said it still believed its offer represented full value for Northern. "We believe that unexpected developments such as this change in tax rates underscore the fairness of our offers," it added.
